statement: OR of n inputs needs n-1 AND/OR gates with any number of free NOT gates (fan-in 2); n=4 needs at least 3 gates. Structural partition-merge proof, no enumeration.

DD absorption follows from light absorption: LightAbsorb -> DDAbsorb for a one-NOT correct circuit with pairwise |S_a n S_b| <= 1 (heavy merges of DD sets disjoint from each other and from non-DD unit merges, plus arithmetic); LightAbsorb itself stays an unproved Prop.
MixedCount holds for a MinCE with no NOT gate (monotone); no_minCE follows from DDAbsorb alone
